correctness.rationale: The source counts distinct literal contiguous Abelian-square words, not occurrence counts or Abelian classes. In a 0^a1^b0^c1^d0^e word, every all-five-run factor uniquely identifies its positive endpoint lengths (i,j); midpoint one-balance requires either b=d with midpoint in the zero run and |i-j|<=c plus parity c+j-i even, or b!=d with b+d even and exactly one endpoint linear constraint. Remaining factors have at most four runs and cost O(n), explicitly <=8n. The continuous diagonal-band bound B(A,E,C)<=(A+E+C)^2/8, parity reduction, and explicit 0^(3m)1 0^(2m)1 0^(3m) construction Q=4m²+m give M5(n)=n²/16+O(n) for every large n; <=4 runs yield <=5n. Independent enumeration of all 6,188 compositions through n=17 matches exact Q and remainder bounds; witness holds m<=20. The proof, not enumeration, establishes all n.
residual_risks: The result is asymptotic at fixed five runs, not exact finite-length maximizers or unrestricted optimum.
